run_comms_compute_bench: run the comms-compute benchmark with GEMM kernels across distributed ranks using argparse CLI
run_compute_only_bench: run the compute-only benchmark mode with add or sub kernels and custom mm-dim values
run_emb_lookup_bench: run the embedding table lookup benchmark with configurable emb-dim, num-embs, and batch-size
run_pt2pt_bench: run the point-to-point communication benchmark measuring ping latency and bandwidth across ranks
run_quantized_comms_bench: run the quantized collective communication benchmark with bitwidth less than 32 and measure dequant overhead
